newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Feb 18.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The German cabinet was satisfied with the Czech parliament's approval of the Czech-German declaration. The Bonn cabinet hopes that after the approval, the Czech parliament will address the mutual decision to create a Czech-German fund for the future and a collective discussion forum.

- CS First Boston expressed its interest in Investicni a Postovni Banka by stating that the bank can only discover its full potential after the entry of a foreign investor. CS First Boston expects that the cabinet will sell its share in IPB by the middle of this year.

MLADA FRONTA DNES - The Czech Statistical Bureau announced yesterday that domestic industrial output increased in fixed prices by 6.8 percent. While companies with more than 100 employees increased their output by 5.2 percent, output in smaller businesses increased by more than 13 percent.

- Machinery giant Skoda Plzen regained control of the second of many businesses whose majority shares were sold to foreign corporations by the former director of the concern. After obtaining Tool-Dorries Scharman Group during the summer last year, Skoda has now obtained a share in Brown and Root Skoda from the American holding company Brown and Root.
PRAVO - During last year, the share of machinery and equipment in total exports and imports increased. The deficit for these areas increased over 1995 by approximately 20 billion crowns.

LIDOVE NOVINY - A new law for health insurance will go through its third reading in parliament on February 25. If the law passes, despite strong doubts from the opposition Social Democrats, it will go to the Senate, which must react within 30 days.
